mapper.select: SELECT t.class_key, c.class_name, t.unit_key, u.unit_name, COUNT(ta.student_id) AS base_count FROM erp_time_table t JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON t.class_key = c.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code u ON t.unit_key = u.unit_key WHERE t.center_code = #{centerCode} AND t.user_code = #{userCode} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm} GROUP BY t.class_key, c.class_name, t.unit_key, u.unit_name

SELECT o.base_count AS baseCount, o.add_count AS addCount, o.total_count AS totalCount, o.yy, o.mm, o.class_key AS classKey, c.class_name AS className, o.unit_key AS unitKey, u.unit_name AS unitName FROM erp_order o JOIN erp_class_code c ON o.class_key = c.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code u ON o.unit_key = u.unit_key WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND user_code = #{userCode} AND yy = #{yy} AND mm = #{mm}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_reorder (user_code, center_code, yy, mm, reorder_type, class_key, unit_key, count, reason, created_at, confirmed) VALUES (#{userCode}, #{centerCode}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{reorderType}, #{classKey}, #{unitKey}, #{count}, #{reason}, SYSDATETIME(), 'unchecked')
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, reorder_type AS reorderType, r.class_key AS classKey, c.class_name AS className, r.unit_key AS unitKey, u.unit_name AS unitName, reason AS reason, count, confirmed, created_at AS createdAt FROM erp_reorder r JOIN erp_class_code c ON r.class_key = c.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code u ON r.unit_key = u.unit_key WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND user_code = #{userCode} AND confirmed NOT IN ('user_cancel') AND yy = #{yy} AND mm = #{mm}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO erp_order_history(center_code, user_code, yy, mm, class_key, unit_key, count, created_at) VALUES
(#{centerCode}, #{userCode}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{order.classKey}, #{order.unitKey}, #{order.baseCount}, SYSDATETIME())

INSERT INTO erp_order(center_code, user_code, yy, mm, class_key, unit_key, base_count, total_count,created_at) VALUES
(#{centerCode}, #{userCode}, #{yy}, #{mm}, #{order.classKey}, #{order.unitKey}, #{order.baseCount}, #{order.baseCount}, SYSDATETIME())
mapper.select: SELECT c.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, COALESCE(o.base_count, 0) AS studentCount, 0 AS teacherCount, COALESCE(r.reorder_sum, 0) AS addCount, COALESCE(o.base_count, 0) + COALESCE(r.reorder_sum, 0) AS totalCount, COALESCE(t.assign_count, 0) AS timeTable, u.user_name AS userName FROM (SELECT user_code, class_key, unit_key FROM erp_order WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND yy + mm = #{ym} UNION SELECT user_code, class_key, unit_key FROM erp_reorder WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND yy + mm = #{ym} AND confirmed = 'checked') base LEFT JOIN erp_order o ON o.user_code = base.user_code AND o.class_key = base.class_key AND o.unit_key = base.unit_key AND o.center_code = #{centerCode} AND o.yy + o.mm = #{ym} LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_code, class_key, unit_key, SUM(CASE WHEN reorder_type = 'RETURN' THEN -count ELSE count END) AS reorder_sum FROM erp_reorder WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND yy + mm = #{ym} AND confirmed = 'checked' GROUP BY user_code, class_key, unit_key) r ON r.user_code = base.user_code AND r.class_key = base.class_key AND r.unit_key = base.unit_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT tt.user_code, tt.class_key, tt.unit_key, COUNT(*) AS assign_count FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table tt ON ta.time_table_key = tt.time_table_key WHERE tt.center_code = #{centerCode} AND tt.yy + tt.mm = #{ym} GROUP BY tt.user_code, tt.class_key, tt.unit_key) t ON t.user_code = base.user_code AND t.class_key = base.class_key AND t.unit_key = base.unit_key JOIN erp_class_code c ON base.class_key = c.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON base.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON base.user_code = u.user_code JOIN erp_user me ON me.user_code = #{userCode} WHERE (me.role_key = 'ADMIN' OR base.user_code = #{userCode}) ORDER BY u.user_name, c.class_name ASC, uc.id DESC
